body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Bluetrek Technologies unveiled its new Bluetooth headset 'Concerto' to enjoy voice-activated, hands-free email and texting without touching their phones at CES 2010.

The technology behind this capability is Dial-2-Do's Hands-free Assistant, a proprietary voice-activated messaging platform that enables users to access the system by dialing a network access number. From there, using only voice commands, they can send, listen and reply to emails and text messages and access popular networking sites like Twitter.
